assumptions.statement: The overall design polygon and three key-area polygons are repository-supplied provisional rough geometries derived from public text, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All calculated areas, ratios, clipping and locations are suitable for conceptual review only and must be rerun after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Official parcel controls, FAR, total floor area, height, road redlines, rail/heritage control zones, ownership, utilities and engineering constraints are absent.
assumptions.impact: The proposal deliberately keeps statutory intensity and height unknown and makes no approval, demolition, investment or construction claim.

assumptions.statement: A complete surveyed inventory of existing buildings, trees, public facilities, structures and operating conditions is unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renew/remove is expressed as a P0–P3 decision procedure rather than parcel-by-parcel conclusions.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap provides approximate road, railway and water context current to the extraction date.
assumptions.impact: OSM context cannot substitute for official survey, redlines, protection zones or current operational confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The seventeen participant-supplied scene images and seven process drafts are AI-generated concept illustrations and may contain invented text, signs, people, architecture or numbers.
assumptions.impact: They are labelled concept-only and excluded from spatial, historical and metric evidence.

assumptions.statement: Projects, governance, events, funding and operating mechanisms are design recommendations.
assumptions.impact: They do not indicate an adopted policy, funded programme, procurement, operator appointment or government commitment.
